policy: Native business terms are preferred. Mode, addition, batch, sorting, serial/ordinal labels and detection grades are never global acronym exceptions. Exact-key field identities, genuine interface/currency/unit names and reviewed locale-native abbreviations are recorded separately. Customer names and raw protocol/data identifiers are not dictionary copy.
